Cross-checks in this pass: BeReal's controls over a photo solve to black ≈0.46 (daily.capture.color.overlayControl), Yope's home header circle ≈0.58.
camera.sendto.color.messageField.method: single-background solve; a neutral grey tint g fits the three channels only for g ≤ 0 (g = -47 for the first pair), so the tint is black: alpha = 1 - C/B = 0.44/0.46/0.48 (first pair), 0.50/0.52 (second pair, R/G; its blue channel 0.28 is off because the yellowish photo above differs from the photo under the field) -> mean 0.48 -> #000000 at 0.48 (122/255 = 0x7A)
camera.sendto.color.messageField.precision: ±0.05 alpha (video; the blurred photo under the field is assumed equal to the photo just above it; the blur radius is not measured)
